verdict.rationale: BigCommerce has a dedicated "Ecommerce Payment Providers & Credit Card Solutions" page, and its docs mention extending checkout and a Checkout SDK, which hints that merchants can pick among several gateways. The evidence is only page titles and one-line mentions, though, and nothing explicitly covers charging in multiple currencies. The multi-region site page names regions but not currencies. Missing for 10: explicit list of supported third-party gateways, documentation of multi-currency pricing and settlement, details of how merchants switch away from the built-in option, independent or hands-on corroboration.
